name: g4.ResolveGroundedElement
title: Ground A Coordinate Against The UIA Tree
description: Physically moves the cursor to the given coordinates, peeks the UI Automation element found there, and - unless skipOffset is set - resolves the pointer's pixel offset from that element's top-left corner.

x.description: The horizontal physical screen coordinate to ground against.

y.description: The vertical physical screen coordinate to ground against.

skipOffset.description: When true, skips offset computation and leaves the returned chain's offset null.
